integrity: Direct finite-dimensional proof with symbolic rational and deterministic quadrature cross-checks. Numerical tests are supporting checks, not a proof of infinite-horizon asymptotics. Bibliographic searches are not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional time-independent symmetric positive-semidefinite two-component linear flows; iid fair independent macro-block order; exact resolvents; fixed terminal T; no forcing. Only centered fluctuations are order h^(3/2), while the total numerical error has first-order mean bias. The result has not undergone independent validation.
title: A commutator central limit law for balanced randomized backward-Euler splitting
